activities.title: Listen to the graduation ceremony. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: todo el elenco — ceremonia emotiva y divertida.
data.script: Diego: Welcome to the Aurora graduation ceremony, live from the school garden! … Ingrid: Explorers, you learned hundreds of words and you never gave up. … Maya: Scientifically speaking, your brains are now two sizes bigger. … Oliver: This song is for you. It's called Ready to Fly! … Diego: The head teacher is giving out the certificates. Blue ribbon, gold letters! … Ingrid: And the last certificate is for… Kili! Best mascot in history. … Diego: Kili is crying happy tears. Condors do that, apparently. … Ingrid: One, two, three… CONGRATULATIONS, EXPLORERS!
